# shumoku_data_source_types (Data Source)

Lists the data source plugin types the server has, with their capabilities and the JSON schemas of their configuration (`shumoku_data_source.config_json`) and sync options (`shumoku_topology_source.options_json`). Requires an `admin` API token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "shumoku_data_source_types" "all" {}

output "topology_plugins" {
  value = [for t in data.shumoku_data_source_types.all.types : t.type if contains(t.capabilities, "topology")]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `types` (Attributes List) Registered plugin types. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--types))

<a id="nestedatt--types"></a>
### Nested Schema for `types`

Read-Only:

- `capabilities` (List of String) Capabilities, e.g. `topology`, `metrics`, `hosts`, `alerts`.
- `config_schema_json` (String) The plugin's `configSchema` as JSON (empty when it has none). Fields with `secret: true` or `format: password` hold secrets.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `options_schema_json` (String) The plugin's `optionsSchema` (per-attachment sync options) as JSON, empty when it has none.
- `type` (String) Plugin type id, the value of `shumoku_data_source.type`.
